objects.description: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used the Invoke-Mimikatz PowerShell script to reflectively load a Mimikatz credential stealing DLL into memory.(Citation: Mandiant APT43 March 2024) [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has also used reflective loading through .NET assembly using `[System.Reflection.Assembly]::Load`.(Citation: Securonix Kimsuky February 2025)
